text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The journey with Stay Gold. Those three 
years had come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now, a little time has passed—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――Oh. Hello there, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Hiya. I came to borrow some more materials

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, feel free to take whatever you 
like. You are a regular here, after all.
choice_data_list:
Thank you. ...Wait, who is that girl over 
there—

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I've arranged a meeting 
today so that we could hear all about 
Sis's past hoofprints—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I was listening to something extremely 
valuable.
choice_data_list: Oh...! I'm curious about that too.
Oh...! I'm curious about that too.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Compared to you, Trainer, anything I could 
tell you would be trivial... After all, I 
was merely watching from afar.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, they were all heartfelt stories where 
I could truly feel Sis's presence right 
beside me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Next time we have a chance, I'd love to 
hear some stories about Sis from you too, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of others besides myself 
who are interested in her hoofprints.
choice_data_list:
...All right. I'll tell you as much as you 
want.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...As expected of Lady Stego. Captivating 
so many people with her running—

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I'll make it so you can't help but love 
me.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-sama. Where might they be right 
now...?
choice_data_list:
I'm heading out on a journey to prepare 
for the long journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Graceful Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
A journey for the sake of journeying, is 
it? Heheh. How very like her.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really is, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure they're having fun even now. 
Even if we aren't close by—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was no way I could ever forget.
choice_data_list:
That's just who Stay Gold is as an 
umamusume.

That's just who Stay Gold is as an 
umamusume, you know.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Ahhh... What a beautiful sky...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "......Are you watching too, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Well now, perhaps I should visit the 
academy for the first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Besides, there are so many faces I want 
to see.
